reviews.text: Best clinic!
Everything is perfect.🩷
Super nice doctor and assistant lady!
Good, fast, professional 😀 …

We have had nothing but good experiences with the Etelevet veterinary clinic. We have been bringing our dog Tóbi here for quite some time now. Whatever treatment we have booked so far, our dog has always received a very thorough examination and great attention.
The online booking system makes it easy for us and works very well.
Based on our experience, the people working here are very conscientious and helpful.
Tóbiás would like to thank you for your work and the delicious treats!😀

During a Sunday walk along the Danube, my French bulldog had an accident, he cried a lot, howled, and barked. We suspected a bite. When we arrived, the doctor already saw that there would be a problem with his eye, unfortunately, the dry weed stung his eye. We received professional and very quick care. After washing his eyes, my puppy calmed down, and the wheezing stopped. We continued the treatment at home, and we were able to buy eye drops at the clinic. Thank you again!
We always take our cats to them, everyone is very kind, they take care of our pets professionally and work at a fair price!
Everyone was super nice, they really wanted to help and they paid a lot of attention to our dog ❤️

Unfortunately, I had a very bad experience. We went with a dying dog, so obviously we didn't have an appointment. They took the data and within an hour and a half an assistant looked at it and said there was no need for oxygen. Meanwhile, the poor dog got worse and worse, but no one cared. So we went to another vet's office, where the dog was immediately given oxygen. After this, I will never go to them again, and I will never recommend them to anyone! Shame on you!

It's great that you can make an appointment, so they always call you in on time, so I can plan my day in advance. My cats' teeth were pulled without complications by Dr. Szófia Karsai and Dr. Péter Tündér. And my dog ​​Gombi gets her annual Bravecto and six-month heartworm vaccinations here, along with the mandatory ones. It's good to know that there's a place in the 11th district where we can come on weekends if I bring the animal army.
Professional, kind, helpful team!
Very kind personnel, top-tier service. Recommended!

They are very kind and helpful, they always treat my dog ​​and me with love. They explain every examination and treatment clearly and patiently answer all my questions. It feels good to know that he is in good hands.🐾 I can only recommend Etele Vet! ❤️ …

I visited the clinic to get my dog ​​vaccinated.
The service was fast and smooth, and the prices were completely reasonable.
The staff is extremely kind and helpful.
I got answers to all my questions!
I can only recommend it!
🐕🐕🐕🐕😊😊

We go here with two cats (Murcus, Lulu) and a dog (Réta), and we can only speak of the clinic in superlatives. 🐈🐈🦮 We really like that they are always kind, patient and pay maximum attention to the animals. It is noticeable that they do not just see them as "patients", but truly care about their fate. ❤️ Last but not least, both in person and by e-mail, they always respond willingly and comprehensively to my 120th worried message asking for help, or if I just need a little encouragement. :) We go to Dr. Szófia Karsai, but we also experienced the same thing with Dr. Johanna Kőrösy during exchanges of messages (e.g. during vacation). We can only recommend them! 🐾

We have been going to EteleVet since it opened with Spike, and we have only had positive experiences since then. ❤️
They are very kind, patient and attentive, not only with the animals, but also with the owners! 😅
We fully trust their expertise, they explain every examination, result and treatment option in detail and clearly.
Another positive thing is that they recommend interventions and do not force them.
You can feel that the interests and well-being of the animals really come first for them.
We wholeheartedly recommend the EteleVet team to all owners! 🐾❤️

We were very satisfied! Kind, helpful and extremely prepared team, who truly care about the fate of the animals. Thorough examination, friendly atmosphere and professional care. I can only recommend it!
I can only recommend a kind, knowledgeable team!
Effective diagnosis, kind direct care

We arrived for mandatory vaccinations, we received very attentive and kind care, I can only recommend it! 😊
The EteleVet team made sure that the examination was a positive experience for our puppy and they provided us with all the important information!

We are very disappointed.

Our cat had surgery at this clinic on Monday, and two of her teeth were pulled out. A few days later, she suddenly became unwell: she wasn't eating and was hiding, so we took her back to the clinic, as we thought it was natural that a freshly operated animal would be examined.

Despite this, they refused to examine her, claiming that we didn't have an appointment. In the meantime, they had time to reply to us by email, but they didn't have time to spend 5 minutes with an animal that they had operated on a few days earlier.

For us, this is a completely unacceptable attitude and has seriously shaken our trust in the clinic. In our opinion, a patient presenting with a problem after surgery does not deserve to be treated this way.

We ended up taking the cat to another veterinarian. Unfortunately, after what happened, we cannot recommend this clinic with a good heart.

Addition to the above: the cat had to have another operation at another clinic because the dentist at Etelevet left the tooth root in. Hundreds of thousands of forints in additional expenses, and an additional 3 weeks of suffering for the animal. There is no dental X-ray, yet they undertake such an operation. No wonder they sent me back with a complaint, let someone else fix what they mess up.

I can only recommend this clinic! From the first minute you could feel the nice, friendly atmosphere and the high level of professional preparation. Everyone is helpful, patient and really cares about the animals.
Dr. Johanna made a special impression on us with her expertise. It was surprising that she even knew the dog walkers in the area, which shows how much she knows the local community and how dedicated she is to her work. We felt all the time that our pet was in the best possible hands.
Thank you for the professional, conscientious and loving care! We will definitely be back and we wholeheartedly recommend the clinic to everyone.
Great team, they always answer all questions willingly and patiently, they are thorough and conscientious, even with "patients" with difficult temperaments. :)
Kind, animal-friendly, professional!

Unfortunately, we had to look for a veterinary clinic in the area because my cat was unwell. I am very happy that we finally chose EteleVet. Extremely professional doctors were able to treat Mici very well, and no matter how bad-tempered and angry he was, they treated him perfectly, with professionalism. I can recommend them wholeheartedly and I am grateful that we could come here and they cured Mici❤️

We received incredible care! We checked in by phone during the on-call time, and after half an hour our dog was on the table. The care was professional, the Doctor's kind, reassuring aura was a huge help to everyone. Both for the dog and the owner.
Despite the on-call fee, the fee was a pleasant surprise. I recommend the clinic with great respect. We are very satisfied!!! Thank you very much for your help!
We have been coming here since it opened. Dr. Karsai and all her staff are very thorough and attentive! I feel like we are in good hands here.
Excellent care, they are patient, kind, and prepared.
We went without an appointment, the dog received perfect care
Everyone was very kind to us, thank you for everything! :) we recently moved to the district, we are very happy to have found a reliable veterinarian. ❤️
Very kind, helpful police officers, and you can count on them even on Sunday!

We went to the clinic with my cat and they helped us with everything. If we needed urgent care, they saw us right away and both doctors did everything they could to make sure my cat would recover. Unfortunately, despite their expertise, they couldn't save her for reasons beyond their control. They were extremely empathetic and humane to us during this difficult time. Thank you very much for your kindness!

We brought our little Maltese puppy on Saturday and he had a stomachache all night. On Sunday we took him to the emergency room, where they were very kind, thorough and professionally treated, and gave us good advice. On Tuesday we went back for a check-up because he was whining again, they gave him painkillers and reassured us (our first dog, we were very worried), fortunately he has been completely fine since then.
Friendly little clinic, easy to get an appointment, everyone is very kind and patient, we were able to be in during the examination, and they obviously love animals. We will be coming here from now on😊

I wholeheartedly recommend EteleVet to everyone! In November 2025, we first visited the clinic to have our then 8-month-old kitten Luci spayed. We are very grateful to Dr. Kőrösy for helping Luci recover with her unquestionable professional knowledge, kindness, empathy and humor!

Since everything went well with Luci, we agreed with the clinic about the dental treatment of our 15-year-old dog Rony. Rony has several underlying diseases, so we were particularly worried about anesthesia. Dr. Karsai was very attentive, patient and professionally prepared, she answered our questions honestly, and it was clear that she really had the dog's best interests in mind. The surgery was performed together with Dr. Tündér, and everything went very smoothly. We would like to thank her for treating her condition comprehensively, taking into account her age and other diseases. The entire office supported us as one and cheered for Rony!

Thank you for your care and attention! We are very grateful!

Dr. Johanna Kőrösy and her assistant, Sára Kasik, are very kind and professional. It is clear that they do their job conscientiously, and are patient with both the animals and the owners. There was a calm atmosphere throughout, and they answered all our questions helpfully. I recommend them wholeheartedly!
We visit here with my little dog. They were very kind and tried their best to make sure my little dog was well. I highly recommend this place to everyone!
I was very satisfied with the Sunday service! The service was fast, helpful and professional, the colleagues were kind and attentive. I can only recommend them!

Dr. Johanna Körösy and her assistant are very kind, helpful, and precise. I feel like my puppy is in good hands with them! :)
It's great that there is a Sunday on-call service that works very well and smoothly!

We would like to thank Dr. Johanna Kőrösy and her assistant for their quick and professional help. We arrived at the Sunday emergency room with a rabid dog, the waiting room was completely full, but they immediately assessed that it was an emergency and put us first. They stabilized our dog's condition within a few minutes, working precisely, decisively and professionally throughout.

We experienced a kind and helpful attitude during the history taking and treatment, which means a lot in such a stressful situation. It was a good feeling to see that they really respond quickly to urgent cases and do everything for the animals.

We are grateful for the help and we wholeheartedly recommend Dr. Kőrösy

Unfortunately, we had a very unpleasant experience with Dr. Johanna Kőrösy at the veterinary clinic today.
We were waiting in line with our sick dog at the veterinary clinic when she came out and shouted at us why we had come. We told her that our dog had had diarrhea for 5 days, to which she asked in a phlegmatic style: “And why on Sunday?”

I believe that no one as a PAYING patient should experience such a tone or condescending attitude, especially in an already stressful situation. People do not choose the SUNDAY duty out of boredom, but because their animal needs help.

I understand that the duty work can be stressful, but this does not justify disrespectful communication. In addition to a professional attitude, humanity and the appropriate tone are also important parts of the care. I feel that there is something to change in her style, because her behavior today was unworthy of a healthcare worker.

I hope that other owners will not find themselves in a similar situation in the future.

Very professional, correct office!
Nice doctor and assistant.
Normal price, I can only recommend it, we went there today and it's a big help that you can go as early as 9 am on Sunday morning.
.
We took the dog back, they said it was a bit of a mess, they pulled it off, they used non-absorbable stitches instead of absorbable ones, etc.

We are very grateful to the EteleVet team! This morning, our puppy, Lencsi the dachshund, had a severe allergic reaction after a wasp sting: he vomited several times, his head and ears were completely blistered, and his face and neck were also very swollen. It was a very scary situation.

The clinic provided immediate, fast and extremely professional care, thanks to which his condition was stabilized. You could see their expertise, experience and the fact that they really care about animals.

We thank you from the bottom of our hearts for the quick and professional help – Lencsi’s life was saved! We can only recommend them to everyone.

Very thorough, conscientious, kind veterinarians, I can only recommend them. My 9-year-old dog and I visited the clinic with leg pain, where the doctor noticed from external signs that there was a problem with his heart, and other problems were also revealed. After thoroughly examining these, he is now well, his health is maintained with appropriate medications. We always receive thorough information in addition to the test results, what they mean, what to expect, and they answer all our questions in detail. My dog ​​is not afraid, he loves going here.
I can only recommend them! They are very professional!
Another doctor sent me to say that our dog could not be saved. Here, your care was done with attention and expertise! Thank you

Conscientious, dedicated professionals!
We struggled with our 12-year-old dog's persistent stomach/intestinal problems for many years, we visited many doctors, but Dr. Szófia was the first who did not use symptomatic treatment, but sought out the source of the problem and achieved real improvement. We still have a long way to go, but we are finally in good hands!
We cannot be grateful enough. Thank you!

I am extremely grateful to EteleVet for curing my dog ​​Zigi! He is almost 15 years old and I can say without a doubt that Dr. Karsai is the best veterinarian we have ever met. She is exemplary in her profession and the way she runs her practice, I wish everyone else in other areas of life were as conscientious and professional as she is. She has an excellent team, whom I would also like to mention (Johanna, Zsófia, Sára, Jázmin) and thank them for the work they did for us last week!
They welcomed us immediately, they are very kind. A place where they love animals!
Everyone is very very nice and professional.

I am very grateful to the Etelevet veterinary clinic. The staff is incredibly kind, attentive and patient. My dog's ears were mistreated by other veterinarians for years, and I was starting to lose hope that he would ever recover. However, here we received an accurate diagnosis during the first examination, and with the right treatment, he was cured practically immediately.
Such expertise and humanity together are rare. I wholeheartedly recommend them to any owner who wants real attention and professional care.

My tabby cat had abdominal surgery in the hospital. After she returned home, we got in touch with Dr. Szófia Karsai and her assistant, Jázmin.
We received every help during the recovery time, both professionally and personally.
My cat received high-quality care in a calm environment.
We became returning patients.

They were very nice, fast and professional, my cat Vilma's vaccinations, deworming and nail trimming were all done perfectly and they were even able to treat the cat nicely, even though she sometimes wants to eat the vets, but she had no problems with them!
One of the kindest and most knowledgeable people I've ever met. I highly recommend them!🥰 …

So far I have only had good experiences with Dr. Karsai. She has been willing to help whenever I have needed her, and has done everything she could for my dog ​​and my son's hamster. I recommend her wholeheartedly!

I would like to respond to my visit today because unfortunately, after sharing our opinions, we only received the medical record, on which I do not know how my cat's temperature could be listed if the doctor never measured it. In fact, no other examination was performed after the visual examination. I would also like to point out that Dr. Szófia categorically refused my offer to hold and calm my pet during the examination, since they are the experts. After the incident, I took him to another doctor and they took his blood without any problems. It is not enough for them to express their "love" for pets in their opinions; it would be useful before they restrain the animal with their assistants and unnecessarily force a funnel on the animal's head, perhaps they examine it as a doctor, thank it, and pet it so that the animal is not afraid. Thank God, this was considered the default in other medical offices, so both I, as the owner, and my cat could leave peacefully after the blood draw. I still do not recommend this place, and I suggest that they approach the animals more kindly so as not to traumatize them for life. I have not understood the medical condition since then.

We took our cat for a blood test. The way they treated the cat was unacceptable, they were violent and wouldn't let me hold it as its owner, even though I repeatedly indicated that I knew my cat and knew that it would calm down in my hands. They were outrageously condescending to me too and they tortured my poor cat rather than examining it. I was immensely disappointed in the place and in Dr. Szófia Karsai. I have never had such a bad experience with a veterinary clinic in my life. I chose the place directly based on Google reviews, but it is certain that I will never take my cat here again. Incompetent team, with an incredibly condescending manner. If someone truly loves their pet, they wouldn't even take it near the place. Needless to say, they only understood their job as far as shaving, they didn't even get to the blood test.
It's amazing how they treat animals and people here. Patience, empathy, care and expertise characterize every employee, we thank you very much for everything!

I highly recommend this veterinary clinic! 🐾
We went here with Mogyi, my Chihuahua, and from the first time we felt that we were in really good hands. The doctor was extremely kind, patient and thorough, she answered all my questions in detail, and it was obvious that she really cares about the fate of animals.

The clinic is clean, tidy and has a friendly atmosphere, which is especially important for a more nervous dog like Mogyi. 🐶 A special positive is that they are not only professionally professional, but also humanly extremely empathetic.

I wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone who is looking for a reliable, conscientious veterinarian for their little pet! 💛

This was our first time at the clinic and it was a very positive experience. Dr. Szófia Karsai was patient and considerate, answering all my questions. I am glad I found this clinic, where you don't have to wait long and the order isn't processed on a conveyor belt. I wish you continued success! We will be returning patients!

Today I took my 16-year-old cat to Dr. Johanna Kőrösy. She is extremely patient, thorough, we discussed the problem very well. The Old Man was a bit hysterical, but they were patient with him. Thank you! 🙂 …

I took my dog ​​here for vaccinations to Dr. Karsai, who is incredibly kind and treats animals well. Unfortunately, after a few bad experiences, my dog ​​has been less tolerant of examinations in the last few years, and it means a lot to him that the doctor greets him kindly and pet him. Unfortunately, this is not the case everywhere, I have had negative experiences in several clinics in the area, but I was happy that the doctor here likes to befriend the patients:)

It's great that there is an online appointment booking system, and the prices are clearly displayed. This shouldn't be a big deal in 2025, but we have been to other clinics in the area several times and if there was a website at all, there was no meaningful information or prices, there was no price list on site (maybe inside the doctor's office in a hidden place), and they only announced the price at the end of the treatment, which was of course much higher than average.
The correct information and easy appointment booking are already a big plus for this clinic, so they will definitely see us again :)

We visited them in the morning in a panic about our kitten. We were able to go right after work. They were very kind and helpful, they answered all our questions. And the kitten received proper treatment.
The doctor really knows her stuff, if there were 6 stars, I would give it that many 😊 …

My dog ​​swallowed a piece of zipper. I called the first vet I came across and told them what was going on. They immediately took him in, gave him an emetic, and then a sedative after he vomited. The doctors and assistants were very kind during, during, and after the procedure. They spoke to and treated the dog nicely. They explained everything, came, and “checked” on him to make sure everything was okay. I was/am very satisfied. I can only recommend them.✅😊

An excellent veterinary clinic where they work with all their heart and soul!
We are very grateful because the team here is not only outstanding professionally, but they also pay attention to the animal's soul.
The doctor is extremely thorough, patient and reliable - she explains everything in detail, and it shows how important the well-being of the animals is to her.
The assistant girl is also fantastic: she is always kind and attentive, which helps a lot in making the dog (and the owner 😊) feel safe.
The clinic is always clean, tidy and has a calm atmosphere.
Thank you for your conscientious, loving work, and for always providing the best!
We recommend it wholeheartedly to everyone who wants to have their pet in real, caring hands.

Very kind, helpful, precise staff. The Doctor is a miracle. She truly cares from the heart and has the fate of every pet at heart. They work very professionally, at an affordable price. A truly caring, attentive, patient doctor and assistants, to whom you dare to entrust even your most feared pet. I can only recommend them!!! Thank you for treating Mio with such patience, love, and care! Plus, they calm the worried owner down like this. <3 :)

This place is divine. At least so far, and we hope it will continue to be so.
The doctor is kind, attentive, it is really important to her that the patient recovers! Even on a holiday, she waits for feedback on what is happening with the freshly operated animal.
She is knowledgeable and up-to-date in medicine, she does not stick to old methods, but knows the latest news.
The clinic is pleasant, you can make an appointment and we have not had to wait long so far. The area is also nice, you can walk the dog a little while waiting.
There is plenty of parking space, although there was always room for the car.
I think the costs are average, since it is very expensive elsewhere. Although we know a cheaper place, we checked in there and got the desired recovery!! :) Thank you!

Our puppy's first visit to the vet went smoothly, the doctor and the assistant were incredibly kind, professional and helpful, we received a lot of useful information in addition to professional care. I highly recommend it!

We have visited Etelevet today with 2 stray cats, which were castrated free of charge through a program. The tests and the other treatments were affordable and the vet was very thorough with her examination and told us everything about old scars and current health issues. Overall, we felt like despite being strays, the cats were treated with great care and we can only recommend this place.
They are always very kind and helpful.

Be careful with the vet who only examines/treats "cooperative" animals, and the "office manager" decides whether to trim the kitten's nails or not. In any case, he trimmed them and vaccinated them, although there was some problem all along. The previous vet, who was around 70, was looking for a solution. Another vet solved it. By the way, the doctor (and the assistant too) are cute...
They were very thorough and kind, I recommend them to everyone! 🐱🐶 …

I highly recommend her to everyone! Very nice doctor, nice assistant, and we are satisfied with their expertise! We got an appointment quickly, both for vaccination and neutering, and everything went well. If we ever need veterinary care, we will definitely come here!:))

Exceptionally kind and professional team!

We brought our puppy in for an emergency (he ate chocolate), and the staff at EteleVet immediately welcomed us. It was very reassuring how helpful, patient and kind they were in everything – not only with the dog, but also with me.

They explained everything patiently, the vomiting was done quickly, professionally and in a calm environment. The puppy was much better that evening, and we were relieved too.

If I could, I would give it 6 stars! :)

Such an empathetic, attentive attitude is rare – we will definitely only come here from now on.

Thank you very much! 🐾❤️

Finally, a nice, friendly and competent veterinarian and assistant in Kelenföld. It was nice that he called me back by phone. I was able to easily make an appointment in the online booking system. The office is clean and pleasant. The doctor and the assistant are kind from the heart, it is obvious that they love their work and animals. Manyi felt at home from the first minute. The doctor is thorough and answered all my questions. The prices are also fair. He has become our new doctor! Thank you very much for your kindness! Manyi and Eszter

Lovely vet and assistant. We loved that we could book an appointment online. They were not in a hurry, they examined our dog thoroughly, they gave us all the information we asked for. We could also pay by card.

Our 14-year-old cat Milli had 4 teeth pulled, her teeth were so tartar-ridden. We went to Fuziovet before, where unfortunately they didn't realize for 25,000 HUF that the patient had been sneezing and her eyes were running from her teeth for days. At Etelevet, the doctor knew what the problem was in about 5 minutes. The doctor and her assistant are very kind and thorough, she answered all our questions in detail, fortunately the dental surgery went perfectly. Cat Milli has been fine since then, everything is fine with her. We will take her back for another check-up next week.

There were plenty of free appointments, they were kind and helpful with us and our cat. The abdominal ultrasound was thorough.
The office is new.

Super new clinic, clean and sophisticated, with fair pricing, and easy to get to.
The doctor is professional and kind, we have been going to her for a long time and have followed her here as well. She is very thorough and always informs in a clear, patient way, and gives useful advice.
I can only recommend her to everyone!
We went for an ultrasound, but regardless, the doctor thoroughly questioned us and examined our dog. We received complete and correct care. I recommend her to everyone
I have a quick question regarding the counter running on the website: how can there be more recovered patients (978) than successful tests (769)?

A completely new veterinary clinic, they made an absolutely positive impression on me. We were there for dog vaccinations, they provided professional and kind information, the prices were transparent and we got it done quickly
It was newly opened, we tried it, it worked. The price was right and we received fair service.
They are very kind, thorough. Their prices are also very fair. I recommend them wholeheartedly! :)
